chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Abdillah narrated to me from Muhammad ibn Isa, from his father, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Asim ibn Humayd Al-Hannat, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

Whoever from among our Shia does not visit the grave of Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) is deficient in faith and deficient in religion, and even if he enters Paradise, he will be below the believers in Paradise.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual consequence of neglecting the visitation of Imam Husayn's grave according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Compiled by Ibn Qulawayh in *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) establishes the Ziyarah of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) as a definitive marker of Shia identity and spiritual completeness. It distinguishes between the ontological status of faith and the experiential reality of Paradise, suggesting that while the negligent believer is saved, their rank remains inferior to those who actively maintained the bond of love and remembrance through pilgrimage.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 1. Ḥasan ibn ‘Abdillāh ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā narrated to me from his father, from Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from ‘Āsim ibn Ḥumayd Al-Ḥannāť, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said: Abū Ja’far (Imam Bāqir (a.s.)) said:

Those from among our Shia who do not go to (the Ziyārah of) the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.) are lacking in faith and their belief is incomplete. And even if they enter Paradise, their position will be lower than that of the believers.
